meta.name: Send personalized cold email sequences with Google Sheets, Gmail, Gemini and Slack

name: AI Cold Email Machine — FINAL FIXED

nodes.name: When New Email Received
nodes.notes: Polls Gmail inbox every minute for new unread emails. When found, passes email data downstream.

nodes.name: Extract Email Sender Info
nodes.notes: Extracts sender email, subject, and snippet from incoming Gmail message.

nodes.name: Read Leads from Sheets
nodes.notes: Searches Leads sheet for a row where contact_email matches sender. If found = reply to our cold email.

nodes.name: Check Cold Email Reply
nodes.notes: TRUE = sender found in sheet AND not already marked replied → it's a real cold email reply! FALSE = unrelated email, stop.

nodes.name: Merge Lead and Email Data
nodes.notes: Combines lead data from sheet with incoming email details for updating and Slack notification.

nodes.name: Update Sheets Reply Status
nodes.notes: Updates lead row: reply_received=TRUE, status=replied, reply_at=timestamp, reply_snippet=first 200 chars. This automatically stops follow-up sequence.

nodes.name: Post Hot Lead Alert to Slack
nodes.notes: Sends immediate Slack notification with company name, their reply snippet, and reminder to respond quickly.

nodes.name: Tracking Pixel Webhook
nodes.notes: GET request fires when email is opened. URL contains ?id=BASE64_EMAIL. Must be Active workflow with production /webhook/ URL.

nodes.name: Return Pixel Image
nodes.notes: Immediately returns a 1x1 transparent GIF. This is what the email client receives. Response must be fast — do processing after.

nodes.name: Decode Tracking ID
nodes.notes: Decodes base64 tracking ID back to email address. Validates it looks like an email before proceeding.

nodes.name: Valid Email?
nodes.notes: Only proceeds if decoded tracking ID is a valid email address.

nodes.name: Find Lead Row
nodes.notes: Finds the lead row by contact_email. Gets current open_count to increment it.

nodes.name: Prepare Update Data
nodes.notes: Increments open_count. Tracks first open separately from repeat opens. Only updates opened_at on first open.

nodes.name: Update Sheet — Email Opened
nodes.notes: Updates row with appendOrUpdate — never deletes. Updates email_opened, timestamps, and increments open_count.

nodes.name: First Time Open?
nodes.notes: Only send Slack alert on FIRST open. Prevents spam alerts when someone opens email multiple times.

nodes.name: Slack Alert — Email Opened
nodes.notes: Sends Slack alert only on first open. If opened 3+ times → extra urgent alert to contact immediately.

nodes.name: Fetch All Leads
nodes.notes: No filter — gets ALL rows. Code node below does the filtering.

nodes.name: Filter Pending Only
nodes.notes: Filters pending or empty status rows. Returns ALL matching rows as separate items — n8n processes each one automatically.

nodes.name: Valid Lead?
nodes.notes: Skips rows with missing fields or no_leads flag.

nodes.name: Scrape + Clean Website
nodes.notes: COMBINED NODE — scrapes website AND cleans content in one step. Fixes the $input.first() issue. Uses $input.first().json which is correct here since each item is processed separately by n8n.

nodes.name: Parse + Build Email
nodes.notes: Parses Gemini response. Removes placeholders. Builds HTML email with tracking pixel.

nodes.name: Send Cold Email
nodes.notes: emailType = html (important for tracking pixel). continueOnFail = true.

nodes.name: Update Sheet — Sent
nodes.notes: appendOrUpdate — matches by contact_email. Never deletes. Updates status to sent.

parameters.content:
## Section A — Main Email Flow
Fetches pending leads daily at 9AM → scrapes website → Gemini writes personalized email → sends via Gmail → updates sheet

## AI Email Writer
Gemini generates personalized cold email from scraped website content

## Section B — Follow-up 1 (Day 3)
Checks if 3 days passed since email sent → sends gentle bump → marks follow_up_1_sent = TRUE

## Section B — Follow-up 2 (Day 7 — Final)
Checks if 7 days passed → sends last chance email → marks status = sequence_complete

## Section D — Email Open Tracker
Tracking pixel webhook → decodes base64 email → increments open_count in sheet → Slack alert on first open

## Section C — Reply Detection
Gmail trigger watches inbox every minute → matches sender to lead → marks replied → stops follow-up → Slack HOT LEAD alert

# AI Cold Email Machine

**4 sections working together:**
A = Send emails (9AM daily)
B = Follow-ups (Day 3 + Day 7)
C = Reply detection (every minute)
D = Open tracking (pixel webhook)

**Google Sheet:** AutomateLeads > leads
**Status lifecycle:**
pending → sent → sequence_complete
                → replied

## Setup Checklist

✅ Gmail OAuth2 connected
✅ Google Sheets OAuth2 connected
✅ Slack OAuth2 connected
✅ Gemini PaLM API connected
✅ ScrapingAnt key in Scrape node

**Sheet columns:**
company_name, website, contact_email
your_service, status, sent_at
follow_up_1_sent, follow_up_2_sent
reply_received, reply_at, reply_snippet
notes, email_opened, opened_at
last_opened_at, open_count

⚠️ All 3 workflows must be Active
